svg.text: OBJECT KEY · room and puzzle order
T target · V visual-only · F foreground
4 T · High fork of the tall tree
6 T · Hanging light line / load rope
22 V · Dead branch support / empty socket
Kofi: 224 art px / 112 logical units. Background stays fixed; props and stages are independent.
Click a stage to view one snapshot; All shows alternative footprints, not a simultaneous scene.
building: Loose bark, board, timber, cradle and branch target. No ladder or finished platform yet.
rigged: Light cord replaced by load rope; beam and cradle rise only with agreed helpers.
rite: Secured low platform, ladder and first tree hut. Loose dead branch collectible once for offering.
months: Two tree huts, second ladder, shared refuge and watch post. Watch board and hand-rope state changes
afternoon: Agreements persist; forest trail open only after Kofi collects travel kit at bank.
